Dear Dr. Filipe,


I would like to know if you can help with this problem. I want to use a mask to remove soil in this work, but the function of removing soil isn't working.
This sensor has RedEdge, Garbage and NIR,  but this error appears when I try running this function.

Please help me.

> EX1.RemSoil<- fieldIndex(mosaic = EX1, RedEdge = 1, NIR = 3 , index = "HUE" )
[1] "3 layers available"
Error in fieldIndex(mosaic = EX1, RedEdge = 1, NIR = 3, index = "HUE") :
  RedEdge and/or NIR is/are not available in your mosaic

messages.subject: Re: FieldMask and Index using Multispectral layers
parts:
Hi Tiago,

My apologies for my delay in answering...! 

In this case, you need first to give some layer number to parameters R, G, and B (even though you are not using them...!). You can´t use the index HUE in FIELDimageR, because it requires the bands RGB. I recommend to use the parameter "myIndex" instead. 

Try the following code and let us know... ok

EX1.RemSoil <- fieldIndex(
mosaic = EX1,
Red = 1, 
Green = 1, 
Blue = 1,

myIndex = c("NIR"),
cropValue = 600,
cropAbove = F) 

Hope it helps.

All the best,
Filipe
